title: Plaso log2timeline：解析器覆蓋、錯誤帳本與可重跑擷取
titleEn: Plaso log2timeline: parser coverage, error ledgers and reproducible extraction
subcategoryTitle: 鑑識時間線、證據來源與可重現分析
subcategoryTitleEn: Forensic timelines, provenance and reproducible analysis
summary: 為每個虛構來源檔保留識別碼、雜湊、解析器選擇、成功狀態及錯誤；建立可由同一來源重跑的命令規格，不需安裝Plaso才能完成算例。
summaryEn: Preserve identifier, hash, parser selection, outcome and error for every fictional source file. Write a reproducible extraction specification; the arithmetic fixture must remain runnable without installing Plaso.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 清點來源而非只數事件
stages.description: 學徒把Plaso產生的大量事件數當成映像完整解析的證明；本案要用來源檔案帳本找到未支援及失敗項目，而不以事件數掩蓋缺口。 為每個虛構來源檔保留識別碼、雜湊、解析器選擇、成功狀態及錯誤；建立可由同一來源重跑的命令規格，不需安裝Plaso才能完成算例。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 加入成功解析卻零事件的來源，與解析錯誤零事件分開；用source_status而非event_count推斷成功。對同檔案多解析器產生的事件保留parser_chain，不能只用時間戳合併不同證據種類。
stages.descriptionEn: An apprentice treats a large Plaso event count as proof that an image was fully parsed. This case uses a source-file ledger to reveal unsupported and failed inputs instead of hiding gaps behind event volume. Preserve identifier, hash, parser selection, outcome and error for every fictional source file. Write a reproducible extraction specification; the arithmetic fixture must remain runnable without installing Plaso. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Include a successfully parsed source producing zero events, distinct from a parse failure also producing zero. Determine success from source_status rather than event_count. Retain parser_chain for events produced by several parsers from one file, avoiding timestamp-only merging of fundamentally different evidence types.
